Two Employees Die Of ‘Airport Malaria’
Evidence: Public health warning, Active containment, Transparent reporting
#Aletheia #PublicHealth

The Daily Caller reports that two Frankfurt Airport workers have died and four others were infected by malaria-carrying mosquitoes likely imported on aircraft, while health officials work to calm public anxiety.

Ground-level evidence confirms six total infections and two tragic deaths among airport staff. Health authorities and airport operator Fraport have deployed traps, initiated genetic testing, and issued warnings.
